title: C-O11: run_worker keeps a worker-posted verdict when its own JSON parse fails; merge_reviewed falls back to result.verdict
spec:
Why: the opus reviewer for T-0135 posted {verdict: approve, ...} itself via bus_post_result, then ended with fenced JSON that spawn.run_worker's extract_json could not parse; run_worker posted a second result {summary, parse_error, ...} without a verdict, replacing the first, and never set review_verdict. daemon.merge_reviewed reads only src.review_verdict or r.review_verdict, so the approved task sat unmerged until the Planner merged by hand (gotchas.md 2026-09-18, T-0139).

Change orchestrator/spawn.py run_worker (review/spec_review/scout branch, the `elif r["status"] == "done"` path): after result = extract_json(...), if the parse failed (result carries parse_error or has no "verdict" for review roles) and bus.get(task_id).get("result", {}).get("verdict") is already set, do NOT post the parsed result; keep the existing one and set the verdict fields (review_verdict / spec_review_verdict + risks) from the existing result on both the task and inputs[0], exactly as the success path does. If the parse failed and no verdict exists anywhere, for review roles post status "failed" with reason "review returned no parseable verdict" and resume_hint={"raw": text[-2000:]} instead of a done result without a verdict; non-review roles keep today's behaviour.

Change orchestrator/daemon.py merge_reviewed: verdict = src.get("review_verdict") or r.get("review_verdict") or (r.get("result") or {}).get("verdict"); no other change.

Tests: tests/test_spawn.py (a) run_worker with run_claude patched to return done output whose result text is unparseable, on a review task whose bus result already has verdict approve → the task result still has verdict approve, task.review_verdict == "approve" and inputs[0].review_verdict == "approve"; (b) same with no prior verdict → task status failed, reason names the missing verdict, resume_hint.raw present. tests/test_daemon.py (c) a done review whose result has verdict approve but no review_verdict fields → merge_reviewed merges the source task (merge.merge patched, assert called with the source id). No new dependency. Commit on the task branch when green. Finish with: summary, files changed, failures-only test output.
acceptance: A worker-posted verdict survives a failed parse of the final text and propagates to review_verdict on the task and its input (test a)
A review with no parseable verdict anywhere ends failed with the raw text in resume_hint, never done without a verdict (test b)
merge_reviewed falls back to result.verdict (test c)
uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests green; no new dependency; only the four scoped files change; committed on the task branch

result.summary:
Committed on `task/T-0141`. Done.

**Summary:** Fixed the review-verdict-loss bug from T-0139: `spawn.run_worker`'s review/spec_review/scout `done` branch now checks whether the final text failed to parse (either `extract_json` choked, or a review-role result has no `verdict`). If it did but the task already carries a posted verdict (from the worker's own mid-run `bus_post_result` call), it keeps that result instead of overwriting it and still sets `review_verdict`/`spec_review_verdict` on the task and its input. If no verdict exists anywhere, review roles now fail explicitly with `resume_hint.raw` set to the tail of the unparseable text, rather than posting a verdict-less `done`. Non-review roles are unaffected. `daemon.merge_reviewed` now also falls back to `result.verdict` as a last resort.

**Files changed:** `orchestrator/spawn.py`, `orchestrator/daemon.py`, `tests/test_spawn.py`, `tests/test_daemon.py`.

**Test output:** all 156 tests pass (`uv run python -m unittest discover -q tests` → `OK`), `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0. No failures to report.
result.review: other account, different model; label PR same-family-review
